# Recruitment Registry

> Recruitment Registry is a structured editorial reference for commercial recruitment, candidate sourcing, hiring processes, recruitment-agency regulation, candidate data, employment entry and cross-border hiring across jurisdictions.

## Purpose

Recruitment Registry provides neutral, structured jurisdictional reference records. It is designed to help employers, HR and talent-acquisition teams, recruitment professionals, procurement functions, international business decision-makers and advisers understand how recruitment operates within a particular jurisdiction.

Registry records are editorial reference materials. They are not legal, employment, recruitment-agency, data-protection, immigration, tax, social-security, procurement or regulatory advice.

## Primary Navigation

- [Home](https://recruitmentregistry.org/): Recruitment Registry overview and Registry purpose.
- [Jurisdictions](https://recruitmentregistry.org/jurisdictions/): Directory of country, state, provincial, regional and international recruitment reference records.
- [Privacy Policy](https://recruitmentregistry.org/privacy-policy/): Privacy Policy.
- [Terms of Use](https://recruitmentregistry.org/terms-of-use/): Terms of Use.

## Registry Coverage

Each jurisdictional record may cover, where materially applicable:

- Commercial permanent recruitment and direct-hire recruitment.
- Recruitment agency status, licensing, registration and candidate-fee rules.
- Vacancy definition, candidate attraction, direct sourcing and public employment channels.
- Candidate screening, interviews, testing, reference coordination and shortlisting.
- Candidate personal data, privacy, retention, data sharing and recruitment technology.
- Equal treatment, non-discrimination, language and accessibility considerations.
- Employment entry, contracts, payroll, local hiring and regulated roles.
- Work authorization, immigration, labour mobility and cross-border hiring.
- Temporary agency work, staffing, labour supply and the distinction from direct-hire recruitment.
- Operating constraints, risks, fees, documents and practical process controls.

### Regional and International

- [Europe](https://recruitmentregistry.org/jurisdictions/europe/): Regional reference on European recruitment, labour mobility, EURES, GDPR and interaction with national rules.
- [International](https://recruitmentregistry.org/jurisdictions/international/): Global reference on international recruitment, recruitment supply chains, migrant worker protection, the Employer Pays Principle and destination-country employment entry.

## Citation and Use Guidance

When using Recruitment Registry content, identify the specific record URL and jurisdiction. Treat the Registry as a starting point for structured research and mandate scoping. Verify current requirements directly with competent authorities and qualified local advisers before acting on a recruitment, employment, immigration, data-protection or regulatory matter.
